body.message:
We have this studio apartment available at Damac Maison Prive, Business Bay. Please find the property link below for your reference:

Link: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-damac-maison-prive-damac-maison-prive-a-129738000.html

Please note that, at the moment, we are able to offer the rate only until December. As per your request, please find the 4-month rates below:

September: AED 8,000
October: AED 10,000
November: AED 13,000
December: AED 15,000

Total for 4 months: AED 46,000

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

To confirm and secure the 4-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit are required to be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you with the next steps.

Thank you.
